evidence: Actual Qwen3-1.7B text inference on authored/reported ASR strings; no audio inference or real OCR capture in this probe
selection: Maximize development exact normalized matches after validator; require zero control failures and zero question/number/negation violations; ties prefer semantic_context, then retain product if no candidate passes
learning: Production extraction and encrypted persistence from an empty private research vault before all cases
testRule: Select once on development; run only product, sections and selected candidate on test; no retuning
lexicalSeparation: Dev/test correction pairs and semantic families are disjoint; generic instruction has no test example
limitations: Single-author semantic labels, no independent review.
Screen text is authored/reconstructed OCR output, not captured OCR.
Reported Codex utterances are disclosed development evidence.
This is a text-rewrite probe alongside a separate complete-audio recognition loop.
